data.long_meaning: Eshithansh is derived from the Sanskrit roots 'Eshi' (God) and 'Thansh' (grace). It signifies the divine blessings and grace bestowed upon an individual. The name Eshithansh carries the meaning “God's grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Eshithansh usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name itself is a constant reminder of the importance of seeking and receiving God's blessings in every aspect of life. It also highlights the significance of gratitude towards the divine and the understanding that all blessings come from the divine.

The name symbolizes the belief that God is not just an abstract concept but a living entity who is always present in one's life and who bestows grace upon those who seek it. It serves as a reminder to strive for spiritual growth and to be open to receiving the divine blessings in the form of love, happiness, and prosperity. historical_references.reference: Eshithansh was a renowned Hindu sage and a disciple of sage Agastya. He was revered for his deep knowledge of the Vedas and his mastery over the elements of nature. Eshithansh is believed to have lived during the 6th century BCE.

Another reference suggests that Eshithansh was an important figure in the Jain tradition, known for his penance and austerities. He is believed to have lived during the 11th century CE in the Maharashtra region of India.
